title: Updating All On Newer Games In The Works

posts.author: ZENWARECO
posts.body:
Well, I am working on a couple new games. Though they are in the works. Work. Hahah.  Though I dunno.  I've used 2000 and 2003 so much that...I have even had RPG Maker dreams.
It was like watching a movie.
Anyway, in the works is MONSTER ENIGMA, and a DANNY'S ADVENTURE 4 which is NOT an edit.  It is actually one that is becoming like an old game I was doing, Twisted Fate.
A deep one too. Too deep.
I had ideas for WORLD WARPERS, which was a comic I was trying to do, then LEGENDS OF INFINITY, which was like Digimon but manlier, VALORA which is an oldschool rpg, much 2000. And nobody does 2000. Anymore. Oh fiddle. LEGENDS OF THE SACRED STONES, which came to me in a dream. Much like Super Mario RPG in a way.  I get ideas from sleep. Kinda weird, yeah.  I have been busy on these things.  Though Danny 4, is not Danny 3, which was with Vladimir Putin, but can't release that one either.  Damn.  So I'm doing spin offs, fan games, and originals.  Waiting for Stranger Things 5.
COOPER, I AM ONE OF THEM. People just don't know. hahah.  I'd be hangin out with ma boi Steve hahah
In life, if you have a son, name him Steve and he just wins at life.  I don't know why this is.  Steve is a winner's name.

posts.author: NachoBelle
posts.body:
Oh man, reading this felt like being strapped to a rocket made of caffeine! I swear, halfway through I started hearing RPG Maker menu sounds in the background and a faint echo of “Steve… Steve… he is the chosen one…”
BUT OKAY! before you end up dreaming about RPG Maker
inside
an RPG Maker game (RPGception ), I must share some advice...
Focus on ONE project at a time!
You’ve got enough project titles to start your own Square Enix branch.
Pick the one that screams at you the loudest (or the one that invades your dreams the
least
) and go all in. You’ll
avoid burnout
, and Steve your future son and certified winner will be proud.
Also, please release the Putin game posthumously. I need to know what that even means.

posts.author: ZENWARECO
posts.body:
Strangely enough I was drinking a lot of caffeine when I was doing these games.
What the...
Yeah exactly.  That's exactly what I'm doing. Dunno if he's the chosen one. Hahah. If he's the chosen one, then we're not really getting anywhere, now are we?
Well RPG Maker WAS in a dream. That's the thing. It was strange. It was like an RPG Maker movie.  Like it was a movie.
So hard to describe.  It was really crazy. (I am a very deep dreamer.)
And that's what I keep writing and journaling. Focus on one thing at a time.
Well, the problem with that game (Danny 3), it was an edit. :/  So I don't think I can do that.  Though like the other Danny's with Osama, Saddam, now it's Putin. Though I did a crystal joke, that Putin is grabbing heavenly emeralds for his master. THE CHORT KING omg. In the lands of Aissur
Idk.  Dunno if that would bring trouble, or entertainment.
I guess I can grab some screens from Danny 3 for you to see.  There is even, a level, that goes completely into Alice in Wonderland, and you can get the Jabberwocky as a summon.
Some customized facesets too.  That little meter, with the genie tells you when there's a savepoint around.  It would go off.  Djinni I called her.
That Zoroch guy I painted studs, leather, and that scar and eyepatch on a Sahagin. He looks like a punk! HEY PUNK!! YOU'RE A PUNK!!
I could name my dog steve...idk.  hahah
